document_metadata.title: 1、EXT. GOLF COURSE - DAWN
document_metadata.summary: Martin Blank, a sniper in golf attire, shoots a man on a distant green with a silenced rifle, then resumes golfing, commenting his shot is hooked.

entities.name: Sprinkler activates and waters dewy lawn
entities.description: A polished brass sprinkler head emerges from the ground and begins spraying water onto a lawn already covered in dew, enhancing the lush, artificial oasis atmosphere.

entities.name: Flock of ducklings crosses golf course without mother
entities.description: A group of ducklings moves across the golf course through the thrushes, with no adult duck in sight, suggesting an unguided journey through the manicured landscape.

entities.name: Golf ball submerged at bottom of water hazard
entities.description: A collection of lost golf balls lies scattered underwater at the base of a water hazard, forming a graveyard of missed shots and errant swings.

entities.name: Palm fronds sway to reveal surrounding desert
entities.description: After being neatly trimmed, palm fronds sway in the wind, momentarily exposing the stark, barren desert that encircles the artificial greenery of the golf course.

entities.name: Golfer chips ball from edge of rough with iron
entities.description: A figure wearing yellow trousers uses a brand-new Titleist 3 ball at the edge of the rough, confidently striking it with an iron to chip it onto the fairway.

entities.name: Golfer cleans iron grooves with golf tee during play
entities.description: While walking toward the green, a golfer uses a golf tee to remove dirt from the grooves of an iron, using two black gloves instead of one.

entities.name: Golfer putts ball into hole from fifty feet
entities.description: In a squat over the ball, the golfer lines up a fifty-foot curving putt, gently popping the ball, which rolls with precision, avoids hazards, and ultimately drops into the hole.

entities.description: A manicured outdoor setting with greens, rough, and water hazards where golf-related actions take place.

entities.name: water hazard
entities.description: A designated area of water on the golf course where a golf ball lies submerged at the bottom.

entities.name: edge of the rough
entities.description: The boundary between the closely mown fairway and the longer grass where the golf ball is positioned before being chipped.

entities.name: green
entities.description: The closely mown area surrounding the hole where putting occurs.

entities.description: A new golf ball made by Titleist, positioned just on the edge of the rough.

entities.name: golf tee
entities.description: A small peg used to dig dirt out of the grooves of the iron.

entities.description: A pair of black gloves worn on both hands while handling the golf club.

entities.description: A golf club used to roll the ball toward the hole on the green.

entities.name: Golfer
entities.description: An individual playing golf, seen chipping and putting the ball, wearing yellow trousers and black gloves.
entities.summary: An individual playing golf, seen chipping and putting the ball, wearing yellow trousers and black gloves.

entities.name: Martin Blank kneels and prepares sniper rifle on golf course
entities.description: Martin Blank drops to one knee on a wipe rag, stabilizes his position with a spiked foot, and readies a sniper rifle equipped with a silencer for a shot on the golf course.

entities.name: Martin Blank fires rifle and kills man in red sweater on distant green
entities.description: From four hundred yards away, Martin Blank shoots a man in a red sweater through the head with a silenced rifle, causing his head to vanish in a crimson mist before the body collapses on the green.

entities.name: Martin Blank returns rifle and retrieves driver from golf bag
entities.description: After the shot, Martin Blank places the sniper rifle back into his leather golf bag and pulls out a driver, transitioning back to the appearance of a normal golfer.

entities.name: Martin Blank hits golf ball with driver and comments on hook
entities.description: Martin Blank swings a driver at the tee, strikes the golf ball, observes its flight, and mutters that he hooked the shot.

entities.name: Martin Blank
entities.description: A professional assassin who uses a golf course as a cover to carry out a sniper killing, blending in with the environment while executing a precise shot from long distance.
entities.summary: A skilled sniper uses a golf course as cover to carry out a precise assassination, blending in with the environment while concealing his rifle, reflecting themes of detachment and hidden identities among characters facing personal disconnection.

entities.name: sniper rifle
entities.description: A compact rifle equipped with a long silencer, used by Martin Blank to carry out a covert assassination from a distance on the golf course.

entities.name: silencer
entities.description: A long attachment affixed to the barrel of the sniper rifle to suppress the sound of the gunshot during the assassination.

entities.name: wipe rag
entities.description: A cloth used to clean golf clubs, repurposed by Martin Blank as padding when kneeling to take a sniper shot.

entities.name: driver
entities.description: A golf club used by Martin Blank to hit the ball after returning the sniper rifle to the bag, part of his cover as a golfer.

entities.name: man in red sweater
entities.description: A silver-haired individual on a distant green who is targeted and killed by Martin Blank during a golf outing, possibly an investment banker or arms trader.

entities.name: leather golf bag
entities.description: A golf bag made of leather that conceals a sniper rifle and other equipment, used by Martin Blank to transport weapons disguised as golf gear.

document_metadata.title: 2、INT. CLUB HOUSE PATIO - LATER
document_metadata.summary: A club member introduces Martin to P.P.P., a spiritual system using a pizza-shaped card with six sections offering daily insights, promoting peace and meaning; he gifts Martin a card as sirens approach.

entities.name: Outdoor Post-Golf Luncheon At Elite Texas Golf Club
entities.description: A social gathering of club members and executives following a round of golf, held outdoors at an exclusive Texas golf club, where philosophical discussions about life and meaning take place.
entities.summary: A social gathering of club members and executives after a round of golf at an exclusive Texas golf club, featuring discussions on life, meaning, and personal philosophy.

entities.name: Club Member #1 shares existential crisis and spiritual journey
entities.description: A club member recounts his personal breakdown and subsequent search for meaning through various religious, spiritual, and therapeutic practices, culminating in a holistic revelation.

entities.name: Club Member mocks spiritual exploration as delusional
entities.description: Another club member interrupts and ridicules the spiritual journey narrative, calling the speaker insane and dismissing the convergence of diverse belief systems as implausible.

entities.name: Club Member advocates for meaning through routine and discipline
entities.description: A club member argues that life's meaning is not found in grand truths but in structured living—going to work, returning home, and engaging in disciplined activities like golf.

entities.description: A club member expresses sarcastic gratitude when the speaker pauses, indicating impatience with the philosophical tone of the conversation.

entities.name: Martin enters the convenience store and observes surroundings
entities.description: Martin walks into the store, scanning the familiar environment of his old home, noting the skateboarder absorbed in a video game and Carl working behind the counter.

entities.name: Carl acknowledges Martin with a nod
entities.description: Carl, who is working a double shift, recognizes Martin and greets him with a nod, indicating a prior acquaintance.

entities.description: Martin replies with 'What's done is done,' then proceeds to the gum section, selects a pack of Beaman's gum, and unwraps a piece.

entities.description: While walking toward the counter, Martin sees a black Town Car park next to his vehicle, prompting an immediate change in his behavior.

entities.name: Martin changes course and hides in a rear aisle
entities.description: Reacting to the arrival of the Town Car, Martin abruptly alters his path and ducks into a back aisle to conceal himself.

entities.name: Felix enters the store armed with Mac-10s
entities.description: Felix bursts through the front door wielding two Mac-10 submachine guns, initiating a violent confrontation.

entities.name: Martin prepares his weapon with gum
entities.description: Martin removes the gum from his mouth and uses it to affix a makeshift silencer to the bottom of his Glock .9mm pistol.

entities.description: Fearing for his life, Carl grabs the cash drawer, places it on the counter, and raises his hands in surrender.

entities.name: Felix shoots Carl dead
entities.description: As Felix advances toward Martin, he fires upon Carl, killing him instantly.

entities.name: Felix pursues Martin through the cooler aisle
entities.description: Felix chases Martin up the aisle lined with freezers, firing bursts that destroy each freezer door in succession.

entities.name: Martin and Felix exchange gunfire in the store aisles
entities.description: Martin and Felix engage in a shootout between the narrow aisles of the convenience store, evading fire and taking cover.

entities.description: Felix leaps over the counter, firing a close-range burst that causes Martin to dive for cover behind the Slurpee machine.

entities.name: Martin reloads his dual Glock pistols while pinned
entities.description: While trapped behind the Slurpee machine, Martin takes a moment to reload both of his Glock 9mm pistols.

entities.name: Felix's gunfire damages the Slurpee machine and hits Martin
entities.description: Felix fires a volley at Martin's position, striking the Slurpee machine and spraying Martin with flavored syrup.

entities.name: Martin retaliates with a final barrage of gunfire
entities.description: After being hit by Slurpee spray, Martin stands and unleashes a full assault with both pistols in a final attempt to stop Felix.

entities.description: After the shootout, Felix flees the scene through the rear swinging doors, exiting in a vehicle with squealing tires.

document_metadata.title: 142、INT. DR. OATMAN'S OFFICE - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Martin, in therapy with Dr. Oatman, discusses fears of domesticity and boredom, linking them to historical male escapism, while expressing growing unease and dispassion about his work, including a recent job involving a younger man.

entities.name: Martin opens the mauve envelope
entities.description: Martin, seated on a leather couch, opens a mauve-colored envelope, revealing its contents.

entities.name: Dr. Oatman questions Martin about avoiding his high school reunion
entities.description: Dr. Oatman asks Martin why he does not want to attend his high school reunion, initiating a discussion about his reluctance and emotional state.

entities.name: Martin expresses alienation from his former peers
entities.description: Martin tells Dr. Oatman that he feels no connection to his high school classmates or to people in general, emphasizing his sense of isolation.

entities.description: Dr. Oatman reminds Martin of a previous discussion about how fear is a psychological transfer of bodily harm associated with an experience, even without direct confrontation.

entities.description: Martin challenges Dr. Oatman by asking why he is not taking notes during their therapy session, implying skepticism about the process.

entities.name: Martin describes his imagined high school reunion as a violent confrontation
entities.description: Martin visualizes attending his high school reunion in a crowded gymnasium where alumni draw guns and open fire on him, leading to mass violence and self-destruction.

entities.name: Martin expresses dread about reunion social expectations
entities.description: Martin explains that he fears the reunion because others will have established lives with families and careers, while he has nothing conventional to share.

entities.name: Martin sarcastically reveals assassinating the President of Paraguay
entities.description: Martin mockingly tells Dr. Oatman that he could say he killed the President of Paraguay with a fork, implying a dark secret or metaphorical confession.

entities.description: Dr. Oatman visibly twitches and nearly spills his coffee upon hearing Martin's blunt and disturbing remark about killing a foreign leader.

entities.description: Martin explains he trusts Dr. Oatman due to doctor-patient confidentiality, but also reveals he knows where Oatman lives, blending trust with intimidation.
